note: Rules for what reaches the website from Planning Center. Every event marked Visible in Church Center is pulled unless these rules refuse it. There is no tag to apply, so these rules are what keep weddings, funerals and internal meetings off the public site. When in doubt, add a word.
excludeNote: Outside groups that rent the building. They are not church events and must never appear on the church's website.
allowNote: Exact event names that may appear even though a pattern below would refuse them. Matt's call, 2 October 2026: Church Council is announced publicly in the Beacon. Only the exact name gets through; anything else containing 'council' is still refused.
excludePatternsNote: Matched case-insensitively against the event name. These are private, pastoral or internal by nature. Any event whose name contains one of these is refused, no matter how it is set up in Planning Center.
